title: bridgesia spicata
intro: Bridgesia spicata, commonly known as Brazilian cherry, is a species of flowering plant in the family Sapindaceae. This plant has been used for its medicinal properties and is a rich source of nutrients that contribute to various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities, which can aid in the treatment of wounds and infections.
